fields.name: indications_for_use
fields.value: Non-invasive processing of CT kidney images using automatic image segmentation and measurement of anatomical structures utilizing artificial intelligence/machine-learning algorithms. The system automatically calculates the renal parenchymal volume. AIRA is intended for adult patients who require volumetric measurement of the kidneys for further clinical assessment.

fields.name: technology_summary
fields.value: AIRA operates by using medical imaging data (CT scans) to analyze the size and shape of the kidney. It utilizes a deep learning algorithm to accurately estimate the renal parenchymal volume of the kidney. The output of the algorithm is a NumPy array that is used to generate a NIfTI file format, which is then used to calculate the kidney volumes.
